title: sibujs-ui registry item
description: One installable unit of the sibujs-ui copy-paste registry: a component, a library file, the base stylesheet or a color theme. Generated from the package source by scripts/registry/build.mjs.

tailwind.description: Tailwind CSS configuration the item relies on. Every utility and variant listed here is defined by the `base` item's stylesheet.

utilities.description: Custom utilities (`@utility`, `--animate-*`) used by the item's source.

variants.description: Custom variants (`@custom-variant`) used by the item's source, without the trailing colon.

name.description: Unique item name. Used by `sibujs-ui add <name>` and as the endpoint file name (`<name>.json`).

dependencies.description: npm packages the copied code imports, as `name@range`.

devDependencies.description: npm packages needed at build time only, as `name@range`.

registryDependencies.description: Other items in the same registry that must be installed with this one.

path.description: Path inside the registry. The first segment selects the install directory: `ui/` → the `ui` path, `lib/` → the `lib` path, `styles/` → the `styles` path of components.json.

content.description: Full file source. Imports of other registry files use the canonical aliases `@/components/ui/*` and `@/lib/*`.

css.description: Stylesheet wiring for style and theme items.

imports.description: Files to `@import` from the project stylesheet, in order, relative to the `styles` path.

requires.description: Stylesheets that must be imported before these (for example `tailwindcss`).

cssVars.description: The CSS custom properties a theme sets, by color scheme. Informational: the theme file is authoritative.

version.description: The sibujs-ui version this item was generated from.
